_comment: grokbotd system defaults, per caller and per OS function (scope). Modes: allow | ask | deny. No blanket grants: '*' and app-wide grants are ignored. camera, microphone and power always ask, whatever is written here. Origins not listed get nothing (deny). Users change grants with the Settings app, 'grokbot-os grant/revoke' or the consent prompt; those go to ~/.config/grokbot/api-grants.json and win over this file. 'local' is the session user's own processes on the unix socket (CLI, MCP, Grok Bot): reads are always allowed, writes use these modes (missing scope = ask). See docs/OS_API.md and SECURITY.md.
